name: handheld
description: Example overlay: a hand-built ESP32 handheld with an SPI display, a microSD slot and two buttons

caveats.shared-spi: the display and the SD card share SCLK and MOSI; only the chip selects are separate, so both drivers must agree on the bus speed
caveats.module-variant: GPIO16 and GPIO17 are only free because this board carries a WROOM module; on a WROVER they belong to the PSRAM and the display would have to move
